name: rep-royale-ui-preview
description: Web preview and UI capture tooling for Rep Royale. Not part of the app. Run from the repo root with npm --prefix tools/preview run <script>. See docs/ui-preview.md.

scripts.setup: npm ci && node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install ffmpeg
scripts.screens: node build.js && node capture.js today compete you-settings empty challenges-tour challenges-empty challenges-none challenges-busy challenges-states-friend challenges-states-finished --no-video
